svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each entry checked against an index (agent); You review the sources, optional (stop); Draft writer: reference fix, when a .tex is given (agent, only when needed); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop).
svg.title: The lit-review mode of the paper skill.
